critical_candidates.claim: Shipped default.json + validateBashCommand/getBashRejectionReason classify as read-only: `gh api -XDELETE repos/a/b`, `gh api -fname=x repos/a`, `sed -n 'w out.txt' in`, `sed -n 's/a/b/w out' in`, `sort --compress-program=sh x`, `sort -ro out x`.
